fine_trace.code: len = *g++; if (8 * len > cend - g) return -1; cli->num_sec_dev_types = len;
fine_trace.note: The Number of Secondary Device Types byte is read from the client info descriptor. Only the remaining buffer length is checked (8*len <= cend-g), but no upper bound of 16 is enforced, so len can exceed 16.
For a new group client device, p2p_copy_client_info is called with the parsed client info containing the oversized num_sec_dev_types.
The copy length is set to 8 * num_sec_dev_types, which can exceed the 128-byte WPS_SEC_DEV_TYPE_MAX_LEN buffer.
os_memcpy writes 8*num_sec_dev_types bytes into the 128-byte wps_sec_dev_type_list array, overflowing into adjacent fields of struct p2p_device and causing memory corruption.
